answer.summary: The most important capabilities prospects keep coming back to are a narrow first-phase workflow for one operational use case, plus visibility into ownership/status/handoffs and run history so they can see what happened. Integration reliability matters almost as much: prospects repeatedly ask to validate required operations for key systems, not just connector logos, and to export events/audit data into their own tools. Security and governance are also major priorities — especially SSO/SCIM, audit logs, retention/data residency, the ability to disable or tightly constrain AI, and contractual no-training commitments.
